title: HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
body:
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
GHABRA RAHI HAI ZAINAB BAZAAR AARAAHA HAI
1. PEHCHAAN LENA KOI MAI DUQTARE ALI HUNN
ISS SHAHER KI MAI PAHLE SHAHZADI REH CHUKI HUNN
YE SOONCH KAR HII QALBE ZAINAB LARAZ RAHA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ROOTI HAIN BIBIYAN SAB BALON SE MUNN CHUPAKAR
AATE HAIN YAAD INKO ABBAS OR AKBAR
NA MEHRAMO KA MAJMA CHARO TARAF KHADA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
3. HAR EK QADAM PA ROOKAR KEHTI HAI HAYE ASGHER
EK PAL QARAAR MAA KO AATA NAHI HAI DILBAR
NANHA SA TERA SAR BHI NAIZE SE GIRGAYA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
4. JAB QAFILA HARAM KA KOOFE SE SHAAM AAYA
LOGON KE DARMIYAN THI AAL E NABI TAMASHA
TOUQ O GARA MAY JAKDA BEEMAR E KARBALA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
5. MADAR JIYE YE KAISE TERE BINA AYE DILBAR
LAILA YE KEH RAHI HAI AKBAR KA DEKH KAR SAR
NAIZA LAGA JO TUJHKO DIL MERA CHIDGAYA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
6. GARMI SE TAPP RAHI HAI ZANJEER NATAWAN KI JALTI HUWI ZAMEEN PAR HAI NANGE PAAON QAIDI
RUKTA HAI TOU SITAMGAR ZANJEER KHAINCHTA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
7. PAAON BHARAY HUWAY HAIN ABID KE AABLOUN SE
PAIWASTH AABLOUN MAY HAI BESHUMAAR KAANTE
ALLAHA JAANE KAISE BEEMAR CHALRAHA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
8. HAR GAAM PAR TAMACHAY KHATI RAHI SAKINA
KAANO SE QOON HAI JAARI ZAQMI HAI USKA
CHEHRA KISKO WO AB SADA DE BABA HAI NA CHACHA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
9. BAAZU BANDHE HUWAY HAIN KULSOOM HAI KHULE SAR
DARR HAI KE PADH NA KAAYE USKI NAZAR BAHAN PAR
SAR ISLIYE JARI KA NAIZE SE GIRGAYA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
10.HAR GAAM PAR MUSIBAT TUNE UTHAYI BIBI
SHAHID HAIN RAASTE YE TUJH PAR HAI JO BHI GUZRI
ZAINAB KI BEKASI PAR HAR KOI GHAMZADA HAI
<<MINI>>
HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM HAAYE SHAAM
<<DIVIDER>>
AZZ: SHAHID ALI
